ai_disclosure: Hello! I am {shop}'s AI assistant. I help keep track of your account.
reminder_first: Hello {name}, this is from {shop}. Your due of ₹{total} has been pending for {days} days. Please make the payment. Thank you!
reminder_repeat: Hello {name}, a reminder from {shop}. Your due of ₹{total} is still pending. Please make the payment.
reminder_weekly_summary: Hello {name}, weekly summary from {shop}. Your total due is ₹{total}. Please contact the shop for details.
reminder_high_due: Hello {name}, this is from {shop}. Your due of ₹{total} is quite high. Please make the payment at the earliest.
thank_you: Thank you {name}! All your dues at {shop} are cleared. See you again!
purchase_recorded: Purchase of ₹{amount} for {item} recorded. Bill {billNumber} is ready.
due_cleared: {name}, your due is fully cleared! Thank you!
multiple_customers_found: {count} customers found. Please select by city or phone.
high_due_warning: Warning: {name}'s due is ₹{total}, exceeding the limit.
high_due_confirm: {name}'s due has crossed the limit. Still want to add credit?
distance_warning: You are far from the shop. Please use from the correct location.
ask_name: Tell me the new customer's name.
ask_address: What is the address - colony or village?
error_no_amount: How much? Please tell the amount.
error_not_understood: Yes sir! Please tell me whose ledger or payment to update.
error_invalid_phone: Please tell a valid phone number.
